text: Professional Overview: This major focuses on the human-environment system as its research object. It mainly studies the changes in the environment caused by human activities and their impacts on humans and the ecosystem, as well as the engineering, technical, planning and management measures that should be taken to achieve sustainable development.Training Objectives: The aim is to cultivate well-rounded talents (in terms of morality, intelligence, physical fitness and aesthetics) who possess a sustainable development mindset, have the basic theories, knowledge and skills in environmental science and engineering disciplines, master specialized knowledge in related fields, and be capable of engaging in education, research and development, engineering design, consulting and management in the fields of environmental protection and related areas.Curriculum: General education courses include Marxist basic principles, foreign languages, computer science, etc. Subject foundation courses include mathematics, physics, chemistry, ecology, and environmental science. Professional courses vary depending on the direction. The environmental engineering major covers water pollution control engineering, air pollution control engineering, etc.; the environmental science major includes environmental chemical processes and effects, environmental management, etc.; the environmental ecological engineering major includes basic ecology, pollution environment remediation, etc.Specialization: It is usually divided into the environmental science major (natural direction), the environmental engineering major, and the environmental science major (management direction). The environmental science major (natural direction) mainly studies the natural migration and transformation laws of pollutants and their impacts on the ecosystem; the environmental engineering major focuses on pollution prevention and control technologies and engineering scheme design; the environmental science major (management direction) explores management countermeasures such as planning, policies and laws for environmental protection.
